title: Fraudulent manufacture or alteration, sale, issuance, or use of disability parking permits and identification cards.
bodyText: Any person who fraudulently manufactures or alters a disability parking permit or identification card for personal use, sale, or issuance to another person to circumvent the issuance requirements of this part, or any person who uses a fraudulently manufactured or altered disability parking permit or identification card to circumvent the issuance requirements of this part, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. The fraudulent manufacture or alteration of each disability parking permit and of each identification card for personal use, sale, or issuance or is otherwise used in violation of this section shall constitute a separate offense.
bodyHtml: §291-52.7  Fraudulent manufacture or alteration, sale, issuance, or use of disability parking permits and identification cards.  Any person who fraudulently manufactures or alters a disability parking permit or identification card for personal use, sale, or issuance to another person to circumvent the issuance requirements of this part, or any person who uses a fraudulently manufactured or altered disability parking permit or identification card to circumvent the issuance requirements of this part, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.  The fraudulent manufacture or alteration of each disability parking permit and of each identification card for personal use, sale, or issuance or is otherwise used in violation of this section shall constitute a separate offense. [L 2001, c 297, pt of §1; am L 2003, c 30, §7; am L 2019, c 87, §8]
